data.title: Use Git Safely to Save and Change Code
data.outcome: See changes clearly, save work in stages, work in parallel, and recover from mistakes.
intentExamples: I'm worried an Agent will break my code

stages.title: See exactly which files changed and how
stages.action: Check the working tree status and diff, and exclude files that should not be committed.
stages.evidence: You can explain the scope of the changes you are about to save.

lessons.title: Git
lessons.tagline: Keep a history of code changes so work can be compared and restored

lessons.title: Diff
lessons.tagline: See exactly what changed between two states

lessons.title: .gitignore
lessons.tagline: Tell Git which untracked files should stay out of version control

stages.title: Save one complete set of changes as a version
stages.action: Select files for one purpose and create a commit.
stages.evidence: The commit can be explained and verified on its own.

lessons.title: Commit
lessons.tagline: Save one meaningful set of changes in the project history

stages.title: Keep new work separate from stable code
stages.action: Complete one change in an independent branch or working directory.
stages.evidence: The main branch contains no unfinished changes.

lessons.title: Branch
lessons.tagline: Develop an independent line of work without changing the main line

lessons.title: Worktree
lessons.tagline: Check out another branch in a second working directory

stages.title: Sync local and remote changes safely
stages.action: Understand the remote differences before pulling, merging, and pushing.
stages.evidence: After syncing, the history is complete and the project still passes its checks.

lessons.title: Pull
lessons.tagline: Download remote changes and integrate them into the current branch

lessons.title: Push
lessons.tagline: Upload local commits to a remote repository

lessons.title: Merge
lessons.tagline: Combine the commits from one branch into another

stages.title: Recover after unfinished or mistaken changes
stages.action: Stash, undo, or restore specific changes as appropriate.
stages.evidence: You handle only the target changes without overwriting other uncommitted work.

lessons.title: Diff
lessons.tagline: See exactly what changed between two states
